sec_edgar.name: SEC EDGAR (submissions, XBRL company facts, Form 4, 13F, 8-K)
sec_edgar.coverage: US issuers + Canadian/foreign issuers that file with the SEC (40-F, 20-F, 6-K)
sec_edgar.freshness: filings appear minutes after acceptance; 13F is quarterly and up to 45 days after quarter end
sec_edgar.limits: 10 requests/second, must send an identifying User-Agent

yahoo.name: Yahoo Finance chart API
yahoo.licensing: personal research use only; not licensed real-time data; may change without notice

fred.name: FRED (St. Louis Fed)
fred.coverage: US rates, inflation, jobs, GDP, credit spreads, commodities, USD/CAD

bank_of_canada.name: Bank of Canada Valet API
bank_of_canada.coverage: policy rate, CAD FX, Canadian yields

google_news.name: Google News RSS (discovery only)
google_news.coverage: headlines + links; facts must be verified against filings
google_news.licensing: headlines and links only; articles are not copied

sedar_plus.name: SEDAR+ (Canadian filings)
sedar_plus.why: no public API; terms prohibit automated scraping. Canadian issuers that also file with the SEC are covered through EDGAR.

sedi.name: SEDI (Canadian insider trades)
sedi.why: no public API; terms prohibit automated access.

political.name: US congressional trade disclosures
political.why: House PTRs are scanned PDFs and the Senate eFD site requires an interactive agreement; needs a PDF/OCR pipeline (planned).

etf_flows.name: ETF fund flows / AUM / holdings
etf_flows.why: no free official feed; N-PORT holdings are quarterly and heavy. V1 analyses ETFs from price and distributions only.

llm.name: AI research summaries
llm.why: needs a paid API key. All scores and numbers are deterministic and don't depend on it.

real_time_quotes.name: Licensed real-time quotes
real_time_quotes.why: paid. Prices are delayed daily bars, labelled as such.
